reason: A Feishu/Lark direct-message bridge that connects users to a DeepSeek Harness agent, maintaining per-user sessions and returning generated text replies.

summaries.zh: 将飞书私聊消息连接到 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，并在同一会话中返回生成的文本回复。
summaries.en: Connects Feishu direct messages to a DeepSeek Harness agent and returns generated text replies within persistent per-user sessions.

capabilities: Receives Feishu direct messages through a persistent connection
Sends user messages to the DeepSeek agent and posts generated replies back to Feishu
Maintains one persistent session per Feishu direct-message user
Uses Feishu app credentials and a DeepSeek API key for service communication
